recorded_configuration: Reel picture sheets + local signed-in Codex gpt-6.1-terra, low reasoning. At most 24 equally spaced target times strictly before the question cutoff, each displaying an actual native PTS. Picture only. Each checkpoint got a fresh independent session with the official prompt. No API key, future images, audio, browsing or shell. Media prepared per source in one pass, verified against the per-item public runner. No item retries based on correctness.
human_reference_note: Table 1 of the CVPR 2025 paper. Ratio of aggregate task performance, not item-level human agreement or a general percentage of human visual ability. Table 1 additionally places EPM and ASI questions at the end of the file. We used the released annotation clocks. See question_clock_vs_paper. The authors publish group accuracy rather than individual human responses in their evaluation repository.
